intro: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is an eccentric dwarven brewer of the Thunderbrew clan, camped out in the Dagger Hills of Westfall. He spends his days concocting potent spirits and speaking almost entirely in verse.

p: Hailing from the renowned Thunderbrew brewing family of Kharanos, Grimbooze left the snowy mountain peaks of Dun Morogh for the windswept hills of Westfall. Known for his jovial disposition and an unyielding passion for potent spirits, he has a peculiar habit of speaking strictly in rhymes, and he answers a traveler's questions only once they have completed a simple task for him. Travelers passing through the dangerous Dagger Hills can find him tending to his private casks, always eager to test a thirsty traveler's palate.
